description: PyTorch Lightning framework for self-supervised learning research with composable objectives, online evaluation, invertible Jet encoders, and checkpoint/resume support.
rules: Check the installed version before using examples from main. Jet and python -m stable_pretraining.quickstart are unreleased additions; install the matching source revision to use them.
Use import stable_pretraining as spt. Compose spt.Module, spt.data.DataModule, and spt.Manager for training; reuse the existing data and callback APIs.
A Module forward callable takes (self, batch, stage), with a dict batch and runtime stages fit, validate, test. Return a dict with scalar tensor loss during training.
For full training-state resume, pass a trusted absolute checkpoint path to Manager with weights_only=False and preserve the original model, optimizer, and callback configuration.
Jet's logdet belongs to the complete invertible token output. Token pooling and projections are not invertible and do not inherit that determinant.
